mapper.select: SELECT recharge_id, recharge_no, shop_id, poi_id, shop_name, shop_phone, power_amount, paid_amount_fen, commission_ratio, commission_amount_fen, sales_user_id, sales_user_phone, redemption_code, settlement_status, settled_at, create_time, update_time, id FROM ai_sales_commission_snapshot WHERE recharge_id = #{rechargeId} LIMIT 1

SELECT recharge_id, recharge_no, shop_id, poi_id, shop_name, shop_phone, power_amount, paid_amount_fen, commission_ratio, commission_amount_fen, sales_user_id, sales_user_phone, redemption_code, settlement_status, settled_at, create_time, update_time, id FROM ai_sales_commission_snapshot WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT scs.id, scs.redemption_code AS redemptionCode, scs.recharge_no AS rechargeNo, scs.shop_name AS shopName, scs.poi_id AS poiId, scs.shop_phone AS shopPhone, scs.power_amount AS powerAmount, scs.paid_amount_fen AS paidAmountFen, scs.commission_ratio AS commissionRatio, scs.commission_amount_fen AS commissionAmountFen, scs.sales_user_id AS salesUserId, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username, scs.sales_user_id) AS salesUserName, scs.sales_user_phone AS salesUserPhone, sup.receipt_code_url AS receiptCodeUrl, sup.receipt_code_object_key AS receiptCodeObjectKey, scs.settlement_status AS settlementStatus, scs.settled_at AS settledAt, scs.create_time AS createTime, mpr.paid_at AS paidAt FROM ai_sales_commission_snapshot scs LEFT JOIN ai_user u ON u.user_id = scs.sales_user_id LEFT JOIN ai_sales_user_profile sup ON sup.user_id = scs.sales_user_id LEFT JOIN mt_power_recharge mpr ON mpr.id = scs.recharge_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( scs.shop_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{shopKeyword}, '%') OR scs.poi_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{shopKeyword}, '%') OR scs.shop_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{shopKeyword}, '%') )
AND scs.redemption_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{redemptionCode}, '%')
AND scs.recharge_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{rechargeNo}, '%')
AND scs.sales_user_id = #{salesUserId}
ORDER BY scs.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_sales_commission_snapshot SET settlement_status = #{settlementStatus}, settled_at = CASE WHEN #{settlementStatus} = 'SETTLED' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{id}
